summary:
D.C. statehood advocates are intensifying their push as the midterm elections approach, with efforts to build support both within the District and across state lines, while recent events including a federal takeover and the deployment of National Guard troops have renewed urgency around the statehood campaign. Senator Slotkin has pledged to prioritize D.C. statehood efforts.

Without statehood, D.C. residents have no voting representation in Congress, and Congress can override any law the District passes.
